title: Point-group operation matrices for cubic, tetragonal, and hexagonal systems

conventions.name_style: Canonical Seitz-like labels use an underscore before the axis/direction, e.g. 2_001, 4+_001, m_100.
conventions.R_blocks: R+ and R- preserve or reverse the out-of-plane direction in the layer-group tables.

basis.note: For the listed D4h operations, the conventional fractional and Cartesian matrix entries coincide.

multiplication.convention: table[left][right] = left * right, represented by D(left) @ D(right); with column vectors, right acts first.
multiplication.reference_order: Order follows the user-provided D4h multiplication-table image.
